extraction.name: EgoLife Dataset
extraction.description: A comprehensive 300-hour egocentric, interpersonal, multiview, and multimodal daily life dataset. It features six participants living together for one week, continuously recording their daily activities using AI glasses for multimodal egocentric video capture, along with synchronized third-person-view video references.
extraction.creator: The EgoLife Team
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Six participants lived together in a fully instrumented shared house for one week, recording their daily activities using Meta Aria glasses for egocentric views, along with 15 exocentric cameras and 2 mmWave devices for third-person perspectives.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: A 300-hour collection of egocentric, multimodal, and multi-view video data, including synchronized third-person perspectives from 15 cameras and 2 mmWave devices, accompanied by audio transcripts and visual-audio narrations.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: The annotation process involved three main tasks: 1) Transcripts were generated via speech recognition and diarization, then manually reviewed and refined by humans. 2) Captions were created by annotators narrating slowed-down video clips, transcribed, merged/summarized by GPT models, and verified by humans. 3) QA pairs were initially generated by GPT-4o, then human annotators filtered, revised, and augmented them with distractors and metadata.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationPlatform: A video editing software with dubbing functions.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: Speech recognition software, an open-source diarization algorithm, transcription tools, GPT-4o-mini, and GPT-4o.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset currently has limited coverage in terms of languages, locations, and activities.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The project aims to positively impact society by facilitating the development of AI assistants that enhance personal efficiency and act as empathetic companions.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The dataset contains continuous recordings of participants' daily lives, including personal discussions and social interactions, and includes data used for identity recognition and tracking.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is used for training omni-modal egocentric models and evaluating long-context, life-oriented question-answering tasks.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: A rigorous data cleaning process was implemented to ensure synchronization, participant privacy, and readiness for annotation and data release.
